headline: Mexican Peso Weakens to 19.30 Per Dollar on Inflation Data
summary: The Mexican peso depreciated 0.69% to trade at 19.30 per US dollar in the spot market following the bi-weekly inflation report.
why: Currency movements reflect adjustments in monetary policy expectations and foreign capital flows in response to domestic economic data.

impacts.name: USD/MXN
impacts.why: Measures the cost of US dollars in Mexican pesos on the spot market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bi-weekly inflation data releases triggered a 0.69% depreciation of the local currency.
